paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss across different types of members and data over a range of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch," has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 3, and is divided into regularly spaced tick labels at an interval of 0.5, with units of epochs. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," also has a linear scale with a value range of 1 to 4, and is divided into regularly spaced tick labels at an interval of 0.5. The plot contains three lines: a blue line representing "Regular members," an orange line representing "Members with near-duplicates," and a green line representing "Held-out data." The blue line starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases steadily to around 2.4. The orange line begins at approximately 3.2 and decreases sharply to about 1.5, then levels off. The green line starts at around 3.4, increases slightly to about 3.6, and then levels off.
